_about: The only place a color is written (D17). Flavors carry a pattern and a brightness as well as a hue (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.5); crates/content/tests/look.rs checks every pair. packaging/package-web.sh turns the top-level values into CSS variables. Each flavor's `dim` is its fill with most of the saturation gone and pulled toward the paper: the unfilled part of its band in the gauge under a cup (Sam, 2026-10-05). `backdrop` holds the store behind the line (Sam, 2026-10-06): a generic shop seen from behind its counter, blurred and washed in paper by web/backdrop.js, in colors that carry no brand.
